[Bug] LMCacheMPConnector under-stores prompt chunks with chunked prefill, causing warm cache misses #3640

[Bug] LMCacheMPConnector under-stores prompt chunks with chunked prefill, causing warm cache misses#3640
Copy link
Labels
stale

Description

GentleCold
opened on Jun 11, 2026
Issue body actions

Label
bug, vllm, mp_mode

Describe the bug
When using LMCacheMPConnector with vLLM chunked prefill, a cold pass can store fewer complete LMCache chunks than the prompts contain. Replaying the exact same prompts in a warm pass then misses exactly the chunks that were not stored during the cold pass.

This was observed with valid prompts filtered below the model context limit, deterministic generation, enough L1 capacity, and no eviction pressure. Increasing max_num_batched_tokens reduces the miss count but does not eliminate it.

This looks related to #2540, but that issue is for PD disaggregation / Mooncake tail-section saving. This report is for MP server mode with LMCacheMPConnector, kv_role=kv_both, and a single cold/warm serving setup.

To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

  1. Start an LMCache MP server with enough L1 capacity for the workload and no L2/eviction pressure, for example:

    lmcache server \
  --chunk-size 16 \
  --max-workers 4 \
  --l1-size-gb <enough-for-workload> \
  --eviction-policy LRU \
  --http-port <port>

  2. Start vLLM with LMCacheMPConnector, kv_role=kv_both, chunked prefill enabled, and deterministic max_tokens=1 generation.

    Example connector config shape:

    {
  "kv_connector": "LMCacheMPConnector",
  "kv_role": "kv_both",
  "kv_connector_extra_config": {
    "lmcache.mp.host": "tcp://127.0.0.1",
    "lmcache.mp.port": <port>
  }
}

  3. Send a cold pass of long prompts, then wait until LMCache store/prefetch queues are idle.

  4. Send the exact same prompts as a warm pass.

  5. Compare expected unique chunk count with cold store count and warm lookup misses.

Minimal workload characteristics:

  • 73 valid long-prompt requests
  • 16-token LMCache chunks
  • max_tokens=1, temperature=0, top_p=1, seed=42
  • max_inflight=8, max_num_seqs=32
  • prompts filtered below the model max context
  • L1-only / no eviction pressure
  • a Qwen3-8B-class model with a long context window

Observed with default vLLM chunked prefill (max_num_batched_tokens=8192):

  • expected unique chunks from offline LMCache TokenHasher(chunk_size=16, hash_algorithm="blake3"): 53,813
  • cold newly stored chunks: 49,851
  • warm missed chunks: 3,962
  • 53,813 - 49,851 == 3,962

Observed with max_num_batched_tokens=32768:

  • expected unique chunks: 53,813
  • cold newly stored chunks: 52,561
  • warm missed chunks: 1,252
  • 53,813 - 52,561 == 1,252

Expected behavior
After a cold pass completes and LMCache is idle, replaying identical valid prompts should hit all complete chunks that were present in the cold prompts, assuming enough L1 capacity and no eviction.

max_num_batched_tokens should not affect whether prompt chunks are eventually stored after the request completes.

Screenshots
N/A.

Desktop (please complete the following information):

  • OS: Linux
  • Python: 3.10
  • vLLM: 0.19.0
  • LMCache: dev branch, MP server mode
  • GPU: single NVIDIA data-center GPU
  • Connector: LMCacheMPConnector, kv_role=kv_both
  • Chunk size: 16
  • Storage: L1-only, enough capacity, no eviction

Smartphone (please complete the following information):
N/A.

Additional context
The current MP connector store path appears to be scheduler-step-driven. In lmcache/integration/vllm/lmcache_mp_connector.py, build_connector_meta() calls _process_new_requests() / _process_cached_requests(), which generate store metadata through LMCacheMPRequestMetadata.GetStoreMetadata().

In the current dev branch, GetStoreMetadata() computes the storable prefix from the minimum of available token IDs, allocated KV-cache coverage, and computed token coverage, then floors that amount to full LMCache chunks. request_finished() appears to clean up the request tracker and call scheduler_adapter.end_session(request_id), but does not appear to perform a final store flush/check for remaining complete chunks.

This matches the observed behavior: increasing max_num_batched_tokens lets more chunks be stored during scheduler steps, so warm misses decrease, but misses do not disappear.

The numbers above were checked by offline hashing the exact prompt token IDs using LMCache's TokenHasher(chunk_size=16, hash_algorithm="blake3"), so duplicate prompt prefixes do not explain the warm misses.
